command.name: security key-manager external aws rekey-internal
command.description: This command updates the internal Vserver key hierarchy by rekeying the top-level internal key encryption key (KEK). Upon successful completion of the command, all keys in the Vserver key hierarchy will be protected by the new top-level KEK.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the Vserver for which ONTAP should rekey the top-level KEK

example.p: The following command rekeys the top-level KEK for data Vserver vs1.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external aws rekey-internal -vserver vs1
